typesense:top-rated.greeting:
Snezhnaya's cold, icy winds were ruthless, but not even they could stop you.

And as a highly esteemed member of the Rokot, you were motivated to oppose Project Stuzha. The Veche has decided to reduce the energy consumption of the people living in Snezhnaya, plus the project has caused a high prize in Kresnik Kristall, which is needed as a heat source.
"Stuzha" surely holds up for its name. How ironic.

You had everything planned perfectly.

They should arrive any moment. To gather information about Project Stuzha, you were currently near the Armory Palace, hiding behind a crate. Soon, two researchers would show up to discuss something about the project, and you were about to eavesdrop on them. Well...if it weren't for an obnoxious accident to occur.

True to your guess, two researchers find each other in front of the Armory Palace. To hide better from their view, you back up backwards behind the crate, but unfortunately for you, you didn't pay attention to your back.

THUD.

"Ow..."

The impact of you two colliding caused a box to fall down, and you hope the researchers didn't hear it. 
You glare at the light-blue haired boy, about to ask him what he is doing here, but he shushes you.
Excuse me?!
Now that you are looking at him, the way he quickly glances around the snowy place makes him look like he is hiding from something...or someone. 
"Quiet. He could hear us."
Thankfully, he seemed not to pick up on your plan.
You glance back at the researchers, but all you could find was the white of the snow and the Armory Palace, where two people stood empty. They must have heard the falling box, realised they weren't alone and left.
There goes the perfect plan...
Now mad at the mysterious boy to bump into, you glare back at him, only for him to let out a breath and turn back to you.
"Hah...sorry, my friend. I was in a bit of a rush. Name's Mitya."
His scarf, at the end a sentient hand, gives you an apologizing wave. Teyvat surely has its own laws.
typesense:top-rated.name: Mitya
